purpose: Teach: 茶碗/はさみ/出掛ける/短冊/さくらんぼ/あゆ/前歯/ヤリ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祖父さまの、本気で、絶対、お茶碗、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見せてもらったわ
lines.en: Aoi, Grandpa showed me his precious rice bowl the other day. He was so serious about it.
lines.style: Warm, animated opening. Quick breath between clauses. Genuine delight in sharing the memory. Soft emphasis on 'precious'—she's impressed and wants Aoi to be too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お料理用の、絶対、はさみ、絶対、新しくしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I actually got new kitchen scissors for the shop. They're so much better.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and practical, but with an underlying note of pride. Steady pace. Light emphasis on 'new'—it's a small upgrade she's pleased about. Easy, conversational tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイちゃんと、本気で、絶対、葵、絶対、明日、絶対、出掛ける、絶対、わね
lines.en: I'd really love to go out with you tomorrow, Aoi.
lines.style: Soft, eager opening with a gentle lift. Pace slightly quickened. There's tenderness underneath—she's asking something she wants. Slight trailing-off as if leaving room for Aoi to say yes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、七夕の、絶対、短冊、絶対、お客様、絶対、書いてくださるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: My customers love writing wishes on the tanzaku strips for Tanabata at the shop.
lines.style: Warm, animated sharing. Moderate pace. Pride in the seasonal tradition and how her customers engage with it. Slight lift at the end—she's looking at Aoi's reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、季節の、絶対、さくらんぼ、絶対、ケーキ、絶対、メニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: I really love the seasonal cherry cake on your menu, Aoi. It's so good.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, spoken directly to Aoi. Warm tone, moderate pace. Emphasis on 'really love'—she means it. Open and sincere, no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、あゆ、絶対、塩焼き、絶対、お客様、絶対、好評よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The grilled sweetfish at your shop is getting such great feedback from customers.
lines.style: Pleased and observant. Steady, warm pace. She's noticed Aoi's success and wants to reflect it back to her. Gentle emphasis on 'great feedback'—encouraging without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、前歯、絶対、笑顔、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、可愛いよ
lines.en: Your smile is so cute, Aoi. Especially when your front teeth show.
lines.style: Tender, genuine. Slow, careful pace—she's saying something that matters. Soft warmth. No hesitation, but reverent. As if she's been noticing this for a while.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ヤリ、絶対、イカ、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、追加したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I added lance squid to the new menu items at the shop.
lines.style: Animated, pleased update. Moderate pace with energy. Light emphasis on 'lance squid'—it's a new thing she's excited about. Ending on 'shop' with a subtle smile in her voice.
